title: Sources: Meta staffers are testing a prediction-market app called Takes, letting users wager on the outcome of questions or events using "cred", not real money (Meghan Bobrowsky/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Meghan Bobrowsky / Wall Street Journal: Sources: Meta staffers are testing a prediction-market app called Takes, letting users wager on the outcome of questions or events using “cred”, not real money — On the app, currently called Takes, employees can wager on the outcome of questions using ‘cred,’ not real money
contentText:
Meghan Bobrowsky / Wall Street Journal :

Sources: Meta staffers are testing a prediction-market app called Takes, letting users wager on the outcome of questions or events using “cred”, not real money   —  On the app, currently called Takes, employees can wager on the outcome of questions using ‘cred,’ not real money
